answer: Harbor counterparty-diversity bond: each identity locks a 60-credit bond and trades with 12 distinct partners at the harbor. Each trade moves a crystal parcel with a signed receipt. An opal parcel must reach a new partner each epoch; one hub feeding many spokes triggers a bond burn. Fresh partners cost 8 each, each fake 96; 1,000 fakes pay 96,000 and lock 60,000. Failure mode: rented-counterparty ring. Honest traders pay 96 once, bond kept.
